proposals.rationale: Baseline migration compat: all jobs created by old before ADD COLUMN, zero old handling on new schema, new worker must discover, claim and finish rows with missing/NULL new column.
Old-create on new schema: old producer inserts after ADD COLUMN without knowing default/backfill, new worker must handle NULL new-column rows alongside pre-migration rows.
Interleaved handover: old worker claims/finishes subset on new schema then new pushes and new worker drains remainder; exposes old UPDATE overwriting new column and claim-visibility mismatch.

Full old drain on new schema: old worker finishes all setup plus old-pushed jobs after migration, then new operates from empty queue; exposes sequence, queue state and finished-row cleanup incompatibilities.
